description: Source code for pipe implementation in Zephyr RTOS kernel, including initialization, buffer management, read/write operations, and synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: k_pipe_init
methods.description: Initializes a k_pipe structure with buffer and size, setting up internal state and wait queues.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_alloc_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a pipe with optional buffer allocation.

methods.name: z_vrfy_k_pipe_alloc_init
methods.description: Verification wrapper for k_pipe_alloc_init syscall, checks object validity.

methods.name: handle_poll_events
methods.description: Handles poll events for a pipe when data becomes available.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_flush
methods.description: Flushes the pipe buffer, reading all data without blocking.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_buffer_flush
methods.description: Flushes the pipe buffer, discarding all data.

methods.name: k_pipe_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up a pipe, freeing buffer if allocated and ensuring no waiters are pending.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_put
methods.description: Writes data into the pipe, blocking if necessary until minimum transfer is achieved or timeout.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_get
methods.description: Reads data from the pipe, blocking if necessary until minimum transfer is achieved or timeout.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_read_avail
methods.description: Returns the amount of data available for reading in the pipe.

methods.name: z_impl_k_pipe_write_avail
methods.description: Returns the amount of space available for writing in the pipe.
